params.contestCreator: Address that initiated (and pays for) the contest

returns._0: True if the contest has been scored or voided

setScores(uint256,uint32,uint32).details: Oracle-set scores are immutable once written. This intentionally favors      settlement finality over discretionary score correction. If upstream data sources      disagree, scoring should fail before this function is reached. If a wrong but      internally consistent result is submitted first, the protocol accepts that as      oracle risk rather than allowing on-chain score overwrites.

updateContestMarkets(uint256,uint16,uint.details: Requires contestStatus == Verified, rejects writes on scored, voided, or unverified contests

params.moneylineAway: Odds tick for away team moneyline
params.moneylineHome: Odds tick for home team moneyline

voidContest(uint256).details: Once voided, setScores reverts because contestStatus != Verified.      Prevents mixed outcomes across sibling speculations on the same contest.

MAX_SCORE().notice: Upper bound on a single team's score. exists to keep         int32(score)*10 in the scorers inside int32 and prevent a permanent settlement lock on a bad         oracle score.

createContest(string,string,string,uint8.notice: Creates a new contest. Only callable by CreOracleReceiver.

getContestMarket(uint256,address).notice: Gets market data for a contest/scorer pair

isContestTerminal(uint256).notice: Checks if a contest has been scored or voided

s_contestStartTimes(uint256).notice: Contest ID → start timestamp (set during verification)

setContestLeagueIdAndStartTime(uint256,u.notice: Sets the league and start time for a contest. Only callable by CreOracleReceiver.

setScores(uint256,uint32,uint32).notice: Sets the final oracle score for a contest

updateContestMarkets(uint256,uint16,uint.notice: Updates all market data for a contest. Only callable by CreOracleReceiver.

voidContest(uint256).notice: Voids a contest, permanently blocking scoring. Only callable by SpeculationModule.
